acceptanceCriteria.text: skills/runtime-clean/SKILL.md exists with name and a trigger-oriented description, under 500 lines

implementationNotes: AC3 NOT met: runtime-clean has no with/without task eval. Deliberately skipped in iteration 1: a baseline agent told to 'clean up' could prune real Docker or kill real processes on the host. Covered instead by tests/test_hk.py::test_orphaned_dev_server_in_repo_is_found_and_stopped. Needs a sandboxed runtime fixture (dedicated compose project + labelled container) before this AC can be checked.
